item.title: Allow python commands to be used on Windows without administrative privileges
item.description: Environment Windows 11 git bash Python 3.12.4 Background The PC I use for work does not get administrator rights, but I needed to use Python. I prepared an environment where I can use Python without administrator rights. Procedure Download Embedded Python You can download Python from the following site and download the “Windows embeddable package”. https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3124/ Unzip the downloaded ZIP file to a folder of your choice and modify the python312.
